# `account_review`

Area: **worker** ([all tables](README.md))

Prepaid accounts whose money or products changed since the worker last evaluated them (lifecycle, entitlement and notification passes). Written by triggers; the worker deletes the versions it evaluated.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The prepaid account to evaluate. |
| `version` | `bigint` | no |  | Grows with every change (account_review_version_seq): the worker deletes a mark only at the version it read. |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `account_review_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (billing_account_id)` |
